subject: Social Media
title: Trending and Amplification
description: A micro-lesson that makes Trending and Amplification usable.

hook.text: The 'Trending' tab doesn't show what matters. It shows what the algorithm wants you to click. Big difference.

buildup.text: Trending creates feedback loops. A topic trends, more people post, it trends harder. Sparks become fires.

discovery.text: Organized groups can game trending. A few thousand coordinated accounts make any topic appear popular.

twist.text: Twitter cut human curation from trending in 2016. Bot-driven trends surged instantly. Automation won.

climax.text: Trending gives mobs legitimacy. When thousands discuss it, each new person thinks: 'This must matter.'

quiz.question: How can organized groups manipulate trending topics?
